newsitem.title: UK: American raises ex-Europe cargo rates 5pct.
newsitem.headline: American raises ex-Europe cargo rates 5pct.

text.p: American Airlines said it is progressively increasing its ex-Europe cargo rates on a selective country-by-country basis by an average five percent from April 1 to May 5.

Managing director-international cargo sales John Smith told Reuters that rates were raised from the UK, the Netherlands and Spain from the beginning of this month, will be increased from Germany and Italy from April 15 and from France and Belgium from May 5.
"There will be no cargo increases in Sweden, where we are already obtaining good rates, nor in Switzerland because of the strong Swiss franch against the U.S. dollar," he said.
From Europe, American operates flights to the United States from Stockholm, Brussels, Paris, Frankfurt, Zurich, Madrid, Milan, London Heathrow and Gatwick, and Birmingham.
Smith earlier told Reuters that American would continue to impose cargo fuel surcharges of about 10 percent on rates, introduced on November 15 last year, until further notice.
